gt_provenance.details: Dataset forecast targets are used; validation/test future targets do not enter target grids.

score_normalization.details: Metrics use raw residuals and truth statistics; no self-normalized prediction score was found.

result_existence.details: R083 and R084 artifacts reconcile, but the historical frozen SPAR extension-code source snapshot is incomplete.

dead_code.details: Audited inference, metric, persistence, and aggregation paths are executed.

scope.details: Four real tiles and one forecast origin; the controlled buffer uses E32N34 seed 42 only.

protocol.details: Validation labels influence model selection and early stopping but not gradient updates; the manuscript now states this.

claims.summary: SPAR wins all five E32N34 splits against LASSO, LightGBM, GRU, and no-anchor.
Three-tile fixed-architecture replication is positive but heterogeneous and is not transfer or Europe-wide generalization.
The 2-km matched-count buffer retains most of the gain in one E32N34 seed-42 controlled split.
Analytic truth supports interpolation sensitivity but not universal gradient recovery.
